Package hadur2.core.port

Class MemoryProfileStore

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.port.MemoryProfileStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
ProfileStore
public final class MemoryProfileStore extends Object implements ProfileStore
A ProfileStore held in memory, for tests and the bench. It enforces its quota the way Robocode does (a write that would pass it fails) and can simulate a robot killed in the middle of a write, so the core's crash-safety (RES-3) can be tested without files.

Quota accounting: replacing an entry counts only the difference in size, as opening a Robocode data file for writing refunds its old length. A delete here frees the entry's bytes; in Robocode a delete refunds nothing, which is why the robot's FileProfileStore empties a file before deleting it, giving the same net effect. A write refused for quota leaves the store unchanged.

Entries are kept in a sorted map and every read and write copies the bytes, so the listing order is stable (CORE-2) and no caller can change stored bytes behind the store's back. Plain Java, with no I/O (RES-6), so it may live in the core.

  • Method Details

    • crashAfter

      public MemoryProfileStore crashAfter(int bytes)
      Makes the next write keep only its first bytes bytes and then throw MemoryProfileStore.Crash, as if the JVM died there. Later writes behave normally. Tests use writes() to arm it before a chosen write, and so cut every write of a save at every byte (RES-3).
      Parameters:
      bytes - how many leading bytes of the next write to keep
      Returns:
      this store
